certificate.module_name: Cisco Catalyst Embedded Wireless Controller on C9100 Series Access Points
certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Section 3 of Security Policy. When operated in FIPS mode. The tamper evident seals installed as indicated in the Security Policy. This module contains the embedded module ACT2Lite validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #3637 operating in FIPS mode.
certificate.description: The Cisco Catalyst Embedded Wireless Controller on C9100 Series Access Points is the next-generation Wi-Fi solution, combining the most advanced controller - the Cisco Catalyst 9800 Series Wireless Controllers - with the latest Wi-Fi 6 access points - the Cisco Catalyst 9100 Access Points - creating a best-in-class wireless experience for your evolving and growing organization.
